      "reasoning":"A new household member using a shared home address plausibly explains the address linkage. The passed identity check supports legitimate ordering, although the newly registered home address does not qualify for the household exception."

  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"Only R08 holds, establishing Linkage. The shared home address does not receive the household exception because it was newly registered. No other adverse family or Context rule holds, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Address-verification failure without mismatched card/IP geography is not independent adverse evidence. Linkage required id_check; that check passed, completing all required verification. FP-2 §5.3(a) therefore requires clear and prohibits further hold, decline, escalation or needs_check. A legitimate household member is the strongest benign explanation. No installments were due, so non-payment cannot support an adverse recommendation. No further check is needed."
